lines.ruling: Ruling: refusal located elsewhere; restatement accepted. i1040gi p. 110, Schedule 1-A, Line 22, column (ii), 'deducted elsewhere on your return (for example, on Schedule C, Schedule E, or Schedule F)'. Schedules E and F are refused by scope.schedule1 (Form 1040 lines 8 and 10), so on a completed return Schedule C is the only place the interest can be deducted elsewhere, and the line takes the QPVLI part of the Schedule C interest; the form note says 'Schedules E and F are refused'. Same as the earlier rulings on this line.
